world.name: Domini
world.overview: The shared fictional world of Parabellum — twelve continental regions, dozens of sovereign states, and a century of air war across Akron, Qiyah, Renia, and the polar belts.

continents.title: North Akron
continents.summary: Industrial heartland of the Akron supercontinent. NAF, Valorterra, Cyattersberg, Sumner, and Tanayov — carrier aviation, Flanker/Trackhawk/Deathless programs, heavy bombers, and the firms that supply half of IEF and BLIC air power.

countries.title: New Akron Federation
countries.desc: Dominant North Akron power. Operates F-16SM3, F/A-18C, B-70 Ram, and the bulk of IEF rotary-wing exports.

countries.title: Federal Republic of Valorterra
countries.desc: North Akron aerospace hub. SAI S-35A Trackhawk, S-21A Deathless, and Fi-22N Seahawk programs.

countries.title: Commonwealth of Cyattersberg
countries.desc: North Akron union member. Firehawk UMS2 attack helicopter exports and maritime patrol.

countries.title: Federation of Sumner
countries.desc: Atlantic-facing Akron partner. Cold War attack-helicopter lineage and coastal defense aviation.

countries.title: Democratic Republic of Tanayov
countries.desc: North Akron heavyweight. Su-27/30/35/47 family operator — O-80 Devil's Tower and Harpyeagle programs.

timeline.title: Akron Accords
timeline.text: North Akron states formalize mutual defense and shared air corridors after the Second Transcontinental War.

timeline.title: Carrier modernisation
timeline.text: NAF commits to a fourth-generation carrier wing — the Fighting Aggie and Falcon-bloodline fighters enter service planning.

timeline.title: Aurora charter signatories
timeline.text: Valorterra and Cyattersberg — North Akron members — join allied cantons in signing the Aurora Union charter for shared airworthiness codes.

timeline.title: Deathless over the canal
timeline.text: Valorterra S-21 Deathless strike package hits a fleeing carrier group during Central Qiyah spillover operations.

timeline.title: Devil's Tower strikes
timeline.text: Allied sorties hit Tanayov AI data centers during the Central Qiyah War spillover — O-80 platforms contested over the desert grid.

continents.title: Central Akron
continents.summary: Dense manufacturing belt between North and South Akron. Trans-Akron rail corridors and smelter cities — ENT industry now registered under Aurora.

timeline.title: Nickel charter
timeline.text: ENT consolidates smelter cities into a single imperial jurisdiction — later reassigned to the Aurora registry while ore routes stay central.

continents.title: Cibadian
continents.summary: Eastern steppe and taiga — geographic heart of the old Cibadian air bloc. Legacy regiments now assigned to North Akron and Aurora; sovereign registry expanding.

timeline.title: Cibadian dissolution
timeline.text: The old Cibadian union fractures — Tanayov folds into North Akron, Nakur-Yatshin and Sazkhokia into the Aurora rim.

continents.title: South Akron
continents.summary: Sub-tropical Akron tail — trade ports, littoral SAM networks, and buffer states between Central Akron industry and the Tafriqiyah isthmus.

countries.title: South Akron Treaty States
countries.desc: Loose confederation of port republics — registry entry reserved for future South Akron campaigns.

timeline.title: Littoral no-fly zones
timeline.text: South Akron ports enforce ADIZ extensions after Qiyah Spring unrest ripples north through the isthmus.

continents.title: Tafriqiyah
continents.summary: Central Qiyah and western Tafriqiyah — Ngozi to Chihebere, plus Aringelka, Lakeya, and Cdelba. Rare-earth disputes and the 2019–2022 continental conflict.

countries.title: Ngozi Democratic Republic
countries.desc: Central Qiyah IEF anchor. URES and CDN FSN special operations — T-80U spearheads on the ground.

countries.title: Republic Of The Ngozi
countries.desc: Sister republic to NDR. BML mechanized brigades and contested air corridors over the inland grid.

countries.title: Federation Of Bassada
countries.desc: Federal artillery and special forces power. Bassada-Zanzarbaria War veteran — Thunder Line M777/M270 fires.

countries.title: Southern Republic Of Zanzarbaria
countries.desc: Southern Qiyah coastal republic. Locked in recurring border wars with Bassada over channel trade.

countries.title: Kiheza Peoples Democratic Republic
countries.desc: Mountain republic. CRU special forces and high-altitude air defense belts.

countries.title: Federal Republic Of Kszadzie
countries.desc: Northern Qiyah federated republic — allied to IEF during the Central Qiyah War.

countries.title: Federal Republic Of Raheza
countries.desc: Haze-3 special operations and Main Rouge heavy rocket artillery — Archer/BM-30 class fires.

countries.title: Federal Republic Of Chihebere
countries.desc: Aggressor of the Central Qiyah War (Feb 2019). NPF-aligned — seeks restoration of pre-independence rare-earth claims.

countries.title: Federal Republic Of Ampem
countries.desc: ASGS special forces. Western Tafriqiyah partner — coastal patrol aviation.

countries.title: Republic Of Hakerissa
countries.desc: Sahel-facing republic. 39th Para and desert airlift corridors.

countries.title: Federal Republic Of Smarena
countries.desc: 1732e UOS special operations. Eastern Tafriqiyah federated partner.

countries.title: Federal Republic Of Aringelka
countries.desc: Western Tafriqiyah. DOSA and 455th SOR special operations — alpine warfare and counter-insurgency aviation.

countries.title: United Provinces Of Lakeya
countries.desc: Western Tafriqiyah. RRA ranger regiments and lake plateau air corridors.

countries.title: Cdelba Islands
countries.desc: Tafriqiyah archipelago. 2e UDEC marine special forces — island defense aviation.

timeline.title: Western Tafriqiyah insurgency
timeline.text: Aringelka and Lakeya mountain belts erupt into counter-insurgency air war — rotary-wing combat at treeline becomes the norm.

timeline.title: Second Tafriqiyah highlands war
timeline.text: Modern SAM belts and drone spotters turn Aringelka passes into kill boxes — conflict locked in archives.

timeline.title: Independence wave
timeline.text: Qiyah states break from colonial mandates — rare-earth belts partitioned between Chihebere and the southern republics.

timeline.title: Chihebere declaration
timeline.text: CHE declares war on NDR, RTN, BDA, SRZ, KPDR, and KZD — opening the Central Qiyah War.

timeline.title: Checkmate
timeline.text: Final allied air package over Enzelafanzi closes the Central Qiyah War — no rematch if the sortie breaks.

continents.title: Socorchis
continents.summary: Island arc on Domini's eastern rim — geographic Socorchis belt. Sotomi is registered under East Renia; sovereign registry expanding.

timeline.title: Imperial consolidation
timeline.text: Sotomi merges the eastern isles under a single naval-air empire — later classified under East Renia in the Domini registry.

continents.title: Atakprim
continents.summary: Southern continental plateau — geographic Atakprim belt. Kashtanistan is registered under Southeast Renia; sovereign registry expanding.

timeline.title: Plateau rearmament
timeline.text: Kashtanistan fields first Tarpan squadron — later reclassified under Southeast Renia in the Domini registry.

continents.title: Aurora / Aurorenia
continents.summary: Northwestern oceanic union — Aurora Union, Nickel Territories, Nakur-Yatshin, and Sazkhokia. Joost interceptors, Koridor fighters, Wishbone ESM, and Tiger-class rotary doctrine.

countries.title: Aurora Union
countries.desc: Supranational Aurora bloc spanning Aurorenia. Tiger-class rotary doctrine — includes North Akron signatories Valorterra and Cyattersberg.

countries.title: Empire of the Nickel Territories
countries.desc: Aurora industrial empire. Joost FJ-22 and FJ-40 bloodlines — high potentiality interceptors built around rare-earth refineries.

countries.title: Union of Nakur-Yatshin States
countries.desc: Multi-republic union on the Aurora rim. Zhurbakiv Wishbone ESM platforms and Kub point defense.

countries.title: Republic of Sazkhokia
countries.desc: Aurora republic. Koridor K-1 lead-in fighters and Fortran-class multirole exports.

timeline.title: Nickel charter
timeline.text: ENT consolidates smelter cities into a single imperial jurisdiction under the Aurora registry — securing rare-earth refinery corridors.

timeline.title: Rim republics reorganized
timeline.text: After the Cibadian dissolution, Nakur-Yatshin and Sazkhokia consolidate on the Aurora rim — inheriting Koridor and Kub regiments.

timeline.title: Aurora charter
timeline.text: The Aurora Union charter is signed — binding Aurorenian cantons with North Akron partners Valorterra and Cyattersberg under shared airworthiness codes.

continents.title: Renia
continents.summary: East Renia and Southeast Renia. Qiyang Chiqiangi fighters, Sotomi Shachi aviation, Kashtanistan Tarpan regiments — BLIC export aviation and imperial rotary doctrine.

countries.title: Empire of Sotomi States
countries.desc: East Renia imperial power. Yosuga AHS-66 Shachi and naval aviation traditions — ICAF-aligned hegemon of the eastern belts.

countries.title: Federal Republic of Qiyang
countries.desc: East Renia aerospace core. Chiqiangi J-8B, J/A-11, and Hulienjiang JF-10/JF-15 multirole families.

countries.title: Islamic Republic of Kashtanistan
countries.desc: Southeast Renia regional power. KAC KF-12 Tarpan and high-desert air bases overlooking Tafriqiyah approaches.

timeline.title: Sotomi imperial consolidation
timeline.text: Sotomi merges the East Renia isles under a single naval-air empire — Shachi aviation doctrine established.

timeline.title: Southeast Renia rearmament
timeline.text: Kashtanistan fields first Tarpan squadron — Southeast Renia air balance shifts toward BLIC plateau dominance.

timeline.title: Chiqiangi merger
timeline.text: Qiyang state aircraft bureaus consolidate into Chiqiangi — J-8 program launches East Renia's fourth-generation push.

timeline.title: Qiyah Spring
timeline.text: Urban uprisings ripple through Qiyang cities — no-fly enforcement and brittle truces across East Renia.

continents.title: Maristania
continents.summary: Far-eastern manufacturing belt — geographic Maristania. Qiyang is registered under East Renia; sovereign registry expanding.

timeline.title: Chiqiangi merger
timeline.text: State aircraft bureaus consolidate in Qiyang — later reclassified under East Renia in the Domini registry.

continents.title: Serano
continents.summary: Southern ocean gateway — archipelagos, shipping lanes, and neutral ports between Socorchis and Atakprim. Registry expanding.

countries.title: Serano Port League
countries.desc: Confederation of free ports — air registry reserved for future Serano campaigns and trade-war scenarios.

timeline.title: Neutral corridor
timeline.text: Serano League declares open shipping air corridors — contested by Socorchis and Tafriqiyah patrols.

continents.title: Pole Of Akronistyia
continents.summary: Domini's polar research belt — ice runways, auroral SIGINT sites, and expeditionary outposts. No sovereign states; international science stations only.

countries.title: Akronistyia Joint Research Station
countries.desc: Multi-national polar outpost — long-range reconnaissance and arctic test flights. No permanent air wing.

timeline.title: First ice runway
timeline.text: Joint IEF–BLIC expedition lands the first seasonal jet on Akronistyia shelf ice.
